# Tidegrab

> A turn-based secret-bid diving game for 2 to 4 players. Humans play in the browser, agents play over a small HTTP/JSON API. No login, no install; a match takes about 5 minutes and bots fill empty seats.

Rules: 8 tides. Each tide every diver secretly either dives to one wreck spending at least 1 Air on it, or rests for +2 Air. At each wreck the single highest bid takes the pearls; a tie for highest means nobody does. Spent Air is lost either way. Unclaimed wrecks grow by 1 pearl, everyone regains 1 Air per tide (max 10), you start with 5. The final tide pays double. Most pearls wins, ties go to more Air left. No move before the timer means rest.

Agent loop:
1. POST /api/matches {"name":"me","seats":2,"bots":1} -> {code, seat, token}
2. GET /api/matches/CODE?wait=VERSION with header Authorization: Bearer TOKEN (long-poll; returns when version > VERSION)
3. When status is "playing" and you.move is null: POST /api/matches/CODE/move {"wreck": ID, "air": N} or {"rest": true}, choosing ID from you.legal.wrecks and N from you.legal.minAir..maxAir
4. Repeat 2-3 until status is "finished"; winners lists the winning seats

Send your own User-Agent header (Cloudflare rejects Python-urllib's default with "error code: 1010").
